title: India's JioHotstar launches internationally without live sports, replacing Hotstar in the UK, Canada, and Singapore; the company says it has 500M+ MAUs in India (TechCrunch)
summary: TechCrunch: India's JioHotstar launches internationally without live sports, replacing Hotstar in the UK, Canada, and Singapore; the company says it has 500M+ MAUs in India — JioHotstar, the streaming platform controlled by Indian conglomerate Reliance Industries, is taking its brand outside India …
